mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200K units, indicating robust demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST surpasses 1200K units.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4% signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing borrowing costs and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, regardless of other market conditions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) drops below 4% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) shows a concurrent 3-month average increase of over 200K jobs, the combined signal of a tight labor market and strong job growth predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators and stock performance
failure_condition: SPX returns over 60d are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.05) in triggered instances compared to non-triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average, signaling strengthened supply chains, is expected to positively impact S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, especially in a monetary tightening cycle.
failure_condition: Walk-forward analysis shows no significant positive correlation (p > 0.05) between INDPRO increases and SPX returns in tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the GDP annual growth rate (GDPC1) below 2%, indicating sluggish demand, predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
evidence_refs: fact:historical GDP growth and stock market correlation
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 annual growth is below 2%.

mechanism_narrative: Whenever the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds the CPI annual inflation rate (CPIAUCSL), the real interest rate signal predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced borrowing and spending.
failure_condition: Walk-forward analysis fails to show a significant negative correlation (p > 0.05) between the FEDFUNDS-CPIAUCSL spread and SPX returns.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a single month, signaling labor market stress, is expected to lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to the surprise.
evidence_refs: fact:historical unexpected labor market shifts and stock reactions
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly more negative (t-test p > 0.05) in the 5 days following unexpected UNRATE increases.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales (RSAFS) increasing by more than 5% YoY, combined with a low unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4%, signals robust consumer demand, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially in an early-cycle expansion.
failure_condition: Walk-forward analysis shows no significant positive correlation (p > 0.05) between the RSAFS-UNRATE joint signal and SPX returns in early-cycle expansions.
